networking._comment: Lane network topology. Absent here until now, which meant the hardcoded defaults in front-end/src/utils/site-config.js were the only record of the live contract.

v2_lab_network._comment: Shared transit VLAN every v2/v3 lane gateway wan0 lands on. ONE ADDRESS PER LIVE LANE, so this prefix is the hard ceiling on concurrent lanes. Declare the block in `subnet`; `cidr` is DERIVED and means the suffix concatenated onto a gateway net0 address, so putting a block there renders ip=100.100.60.32100.100.60.0/22. Widening requires the matching prefix on the OPNsense VLAN-60 interface FIRST, or new lanes come up with no route and the deploy still reports success.
v2_lab_network.reserved_comment: Addresses the allocator must never hand out. The subnet gateway, network and broadcast are excluded automatically; list anything else on this VLAN that CyberCore does not manage.

probe._comment: Before committing an address the allocator arpings it from a cluster node. `interface` MUST be the tagged VLAN device (vmbr0.60), not the bare bridge: vmbr0 carries VLAN 60 only as tagged frames for guests, so an untagged probe never sees a lane gateway and reports every address free. If arping or the interface is missing the allocator REFUSES rather than guessing; set enabled=false to allocate from the database alone.

v1_lane_subnet._comment: Legacy v1 lanes share one LAN subnet, isolated by the per-lane gateway LXC.

module_networks._comment: v1 per-module transit gateways. A module with a null gateway is declared but not wired.
